sec.title: September 1 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 532)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 1** across the epochal radio outbreak of World War II on September 1, 1939, Association of American Railroads operettas, and Australian television/radio comedy revues, Alvar Liddell reporting the Nazi invasion of Poland, Ignacy Jan Paderewski's international appeal, German state radio propaganda on *Jupp und Willie* (1939), Gordon MacRae and Dorothy Kirsten on *The Railroad Hour* (1952), and Graham Kennedy (1939–1979):
